items: Circuit breaker isolation and earthing is required.
A work permit must be issued.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes etc.
Change remote/local control switch to local position.
Multimeter, blower, gas detector, buzzer, screwdriver and set of common keys.
Checks supply voltage.
Check number of switching operations, through the counter.
Check screw joints of the electric connections by pulling, retighten if necessary.
Check pull-relief's at cables
Check mechanical connections at drive or auxiliary switch by visual control for tightness and wear.
Check mechanical position indicator.
Clean protective pipe of the position indicator by means of a cleansing a gent containing soap.
Grease threaded spindle and pain bearing of auxiliary switch (27)

Check functioning of torque clutch. rated value of slip friction torue
Max 10 Nm, min. T Nm
Check density of shaft seap in housing cover (2) by sniffing,
Check functioning of auxiliary- switch contacts.
Check functioning of heating resistor.

Check contact penetration depth rated valve.
Max. 138 mm/min.146 mm/min 134 mm. Until touching/separation of contacts stroke of switch rod 185+1-2 mm. Using Dople Test Equipment.
Check wear of annular contacts and switch rod 1) 2)
Check threaded spindle (10) with universal joints for damages and grease if necessary 1) 2)
Check slides rod (11) for damages; clean and grease.
Execute test switching operations
Check electrical position signals (position indicator)

Check running time of drive.
Compare with reference valves from commissioning
